limitations: Call analysis used typechecked package loading where available.
Call graph results are repository-local.
Dynamic dispatch, reflection, and complex function-value flows are not fully resolved.
Imported-package receiver methods are external boundary signals; dependency internals are not analyzed.
Entry point classification is heuristic: main functions, test functions, selected stdlib net/http handlers, exported functions, and functions with no local callers.
Framework-specific routers, custom routers, custom runtime wiring, and CLI command handlers are not inferred yet.

Public and no-local-caller entrypoint kinds are external-invocation heuristics.
